title: Desk config, validator and the catalogue verbs
objective: The utility's skeleton and the desk catalogue. `utilz generate arngz` scaffolds `opt/arngz/`, `bin/arngz` and `help/arngz.md`; `arngz.yaml` declares the dependencies doctor reports. The desk schema from the design, its validator (one function, every refusal naming desk, path and value), and the file-backed verbs: `list`, `show`, `delete`, and the catalogue half of `init`. The bats suite runs on every CI leg with `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` pointed at fixtures. No Hammerspoon call yet.
